design_notes.definition_of_the_gate_rows: Each new Section-1 row states: what the operator decides (H-CONSOLIDATION: authorize an actual simplification or consolidation chosen from a simplification review's recorded candidates; H-GA: declare general availability against an assembled dossier, operator-only, once), the trigger and ordering rule (decision recorded in run_state operator_gate_decision BEFORE the act, per NDEBT-018), the record-but-never-self-execute rule, the source (ecosystem/06 Sec 5 / ecosystem/08 Sec 5 and product_spec_014), and the disposition: DEFINED <implementation date> (phase 014, feature 099) -- OUTSTANDING; NOT EXERCISED. The semantics are taken verbatim from the two protocol documents' Section 5; the contract invents no new gate semantics.

attempt_isolation.authority: methodology/03_circuit_breaker.md Sec 3.1 (attempt isolation) and Sec 4 (breach procedure); the mechanics below were decided by the Orchestrator and are recorded here so Loop 2 is executable.
attempt_isolation.attempt_base: After Loop 1 approval the Orchestrator commits the approved contract on branch phase/014-099-ga-activation-wave together with its own run_state and verdict files. That commit, <B>, is the attempt base, so the contract that S1 and S3 read exists in every attempt root. All diff anchors in S3, S4 and S8-S12 stay at 483f016 (the pre-feature base) so they still compare the deliverable against the original tree.
attempt_isolation.worktree_creation: The ORCHESTRATOR (not the Generator) creates each attempt worktree: `git worktree add --detach /home/cnross/workspace02/nizam-wt-099-attempt<N> <B>` (N = 1..3), a validated path outside the shared tree, and passes the path to the Generator. The attempt root and <B> are recorded before any edit. The Generator edits, runs AT1-AT8 and runs S1-S12 ONLY inside that root, capturing evidence inside the root under .agent/evidence/099/. If `git worktree add` fails, HALT and escalate to the human; never fall back to the shared worktree.
attempt_isolation.promotion: The Generator commits the deliverable plus its evidence in the attempt root as a single commit. The Orchestrator then runs `git cherry-pick <attempt-commit>` onto phase/014-099-ga-activation-wave in the shared tree and only after that removes the attempt root with `git worktree remove`. Validator Mode B reviews `git diff <B>..HEAD` plus untracked files in the shared tree. The Evaluator re-runs AT1-AT8 and S1-S12 in its own execution context against the promoted tree and writes its evidence under .agent/evidence/099/qa/ (covered by the S3 allowlist).
attempt_isolation.failure: Capture evidence in the root; copy the root's .agent/evidence/099/ directory to .agent/evidence/099/failed-attempt<N>/ in the shared tree; then remove only that exact root with `git worktree remove`. If the root cannot be proved attempt-owned, leave it, record it and escalate. No repository-wide reset or clean is ever used. On exhaustion (third failed attempt; attempt 4 forbidden): per Sec 4 -- quarantine the third attempt's evidence, set step 099 BLOCKED in docs/planning/phase_014.yaml FIRST, the Orchestrator then repairs the derived run_state in a separate idempotent operation, log to docs/planning/DEBT.md (phase, feature, failure type, evidence reference), escalate to a human and terminate.

design_notes.rollback: All changes are confined to text/JSON files on the feature branch phase/014-099-ga-activation-wave. See design_notes.attempt_isolation for the attempt-isolation, promotion and failure mechanics; they are the rollback mechanism for Loop 2 because nothing reaches the shared tree until the Orchestrator cherry-picks a successful single attempt commit, so a failed attempt is rolled back by evidence capture followed by `git worktree remove` of that exact root, with no change to undo in the shared tree. After promotion, rollback is `git revert` of the cherry-picked 099 commit on the feature branch. Any residual uncommitted state in the shared tree is restored with this explicit path list only, which EXCLUDES .agent/run_state.json and every other Orchestrator-owned file: `git checkout <B> -- ecosystem/06_simplification_review.md ecosystem/08_ga_gate.md NIZAM.json tools/skill.json docs/guide/index.html docs/planning/operator_gates.md ecosystem/README.md CHANGELOG.md docs/planning/phase_014.yaml`, plus removal of the untracked .agent/evidence/099/ by its explicit path. Nothing is released, tagged, pushed to a consumer, migrated or externally registered, so no external state needs undoing. Exhaustion follows methodology/03_circuit_breaker.md Sec 4 as written in design_notes.attempt_isolation.failure.
